title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Encounter
label: ch:ar-first-reading
canDo: I can read familiar Arabic words without romanization, follow complete lines in right-to-left script, and understand a connected encounter from greeting through a choice to farewell.

payoff.summary: One complete Arabic encounter made only from previously taught forms and glyphs, with the script carrying greeting, names, a choice and farewell without a romanized line underneath.
